summary: Frontend-only verification of CI e2e admin-email fix. All 5 requested flows PASS against preview URL. admin@stoicaibot.com/admin123 logs in and dashboard-header renders; /accounts and /trades render successfully; /settings shows profile-section, password-section, twofa-section with 0 must-change-password-banner; wrong current password is rejected with visible error 'Current password is incorrect'. site-footer present once on /settings and does not overlap interactive controls. Fix confirmed.

issues: Recharts warnings: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — a container is briefly rendered with 0 dimensions before data loads. Cosmetic console noise only.

critical_code_review_comments: Recharts ResponsiveContainer warning suggests parent container lacks explicit min height/width when chart mounts pre-data; consider setting minHeight to avoid noisy console warnings.
Multiple 401s appear in console before login completes (likely /api/auth/me probe on public /login route). Consider gating the auth-probe on unauthenticated routes to reduce log noise.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CI e2e admin email default change (admin@stoicaibot.com) is verified working in preview. Both admin@stoicaibot.com and admin@trading.bot exist in preview DB with admin123. Do not enroll 2FA on admin@trading.bot. Preview keeps ADMIN_MFA_ENFORCED=false, must-change-password false. Recharts container warning is pre-existing cosmetic noise unrelated to this fix.
rca of the issue: Original CI failure: e2e/tests/helpers.ts defaulted ADMIN_EMAIL to admin@trading.bot but backend seed_admin() defaults to admin@stoicaibot.com when ADMIN_EMAIL env unset (CI case), so fresh CI DB rejected the login. Fix (helpers.ts default → admin@stoicaibot.com) confirmed via live login in preview reaching dashboard-header.
